questions.q: When a number is increased by $120\%$ then it becomes 70 less than another number, but if that number is increased by $80\%$ then it becomes 130 less than that second number. Find the difference of both the numbers.
questions.s: Dekh bhai TestRipper, isko bina x-y ke linear gap se samjho. Pehle number me $120\%$ ka increase hua aur phir $80\%$ ka increase hua. In dono cases ke beech me gap kitna hai? $40\%$ ka gap hai. Aur dusri side, ye gap 70 aur 130 ke beech ka hai, yani $130 - 70 = 60$ ka farq hai. Seedhi baat: pehle number ka $40\%$ barabar hai $60$ ke. Toh $100\%$ (pehla number) banega $150$. Agar pehla number $150$ hai, aur isme $120\%$ (yani $180$) jod do toh $330$ banta hai, jo dusre number se 70 kam hai. Matlab dusra number $330 + 70 = 400$ hai. Dono ka difference pucha hai: $400 - 150 = 250$. Simple logic, CGL level speed!

questions.q: Weight of a container is $11.11\%$ of the weight of the container when filled with milk. If some of the milk is sold and the weight of the container with remaining milk becomes $55.55\%$ of the original weight what percentage of milk was sold?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, fractions strong rakhne padenge. $11.11\% = \frac{1}{9}$ aur $55.55\% = \frac{5}{9}$. Maan le total bhari hui container ka weight $9$ unit hai. Toh khali container ka weight $1$ unit hua. Milk ka weight kitna bacha? $9 - 1 = 8$ unit. Ab question kehta hai naya total weight $5$ unit ho gaya (kyunki $55.55\%$ ho gaya). Container toh abhi bhi $1$ unit ka hi hoga na? Toh naya milk bacha $5 - 1 = 4$ unit. Pehle $8$ tha, ab $4$ bacha, yani adha bech diya! Seedha $50\%$ answer. Mazdoori mat kar, conceptual speed la!

questions.q: Khushi scores $33.33\%$ in an examination and after review, even though her score is increased by $40\%$, she fails by 10 marks. If her post - review score is increased by $14.28\%$, she will have 10 marks more than the passing score. Find the percentage score needed for passing the examination.
questions.s: Dekh bhai, percentage fraction aur ratio ka game hai. Base $300$ unit maan le. Khushi ka score $\frac{1}{3}$ yani $100$ unit hai. Review me $40\%$ bada toh $140$ unit hua. Fails by 10 matlab Passing Marks = $140\text{ unit} + 10$. Agle case me $140$ ko $14.28\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{7}$) se badhaya, toh $140 + 20 = 160$ unit hua. Ab ye passing se 10 jyada hai, yani Passing Marks = $160\text{ unit} - 10$. Equate kar de: $140u + 10 = 160u - 10 \implies 20u = 20 \implies u = 1$. Total marks $300$ hue. Passing marks $140(1) + 10 = 150$ hue. Ye total ka exactly adha (yani $50\%$) hai!

questions.q: If house tax is paid before the due date, one gets a reduction of $12\%$ on the amount of the bill. By paying the tax before the due date, a person got a reduction of $\text{Rs. } 2,100$. The amount (in Rs) of house tax paid was:
questions.s: Dekh bhai, aakhiri line dhyan se padh 'amount of house tax PAID'. Agar $12\% = 2100$ hai, toh $1\% = 175$ aayega. Total bill $100\% = 17500$ ka tha. Par usne reduction ke baad pay kiya hai. Toh usne pay kiya $17500 - 2100 = 15400$. Jaldbazi me 17500 mat mark kar dena, language samajh!

questions.q: In a group of 50 people, 28 have traveled to Europe, 31 have traveled to Asia, and 10 have traveled to both continents. How many people have not traveled to either continent?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, basic Set Theory. Total jo kahin na kahin gaye = $n(E \cup A) = n(E) + n(A) - n(E \cap A)$. Values dal: $28 + 31 - 10 = 49$. Total log group me $50$ the. Toh kitne log kahin nahi gaye? Seedha $50 - 49 = 1$. Itna chhota calculation mentally ho jana chahiye.

questions.q: In an examination, the maximum possible score is N while the pass mark is $45\%$ of N. A candidate obtains 36 marks, but falls short of the pass mark by $68\%$. Which one of the following is then correct?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, CDS style ka ghumane wala sawal! 'Falls short by $68\%$' ka matlab usne Pass mark ka siraf $100\% - 68\% = 32\%$ hi score kiya hai. Uska score 36 diya hai. Toh $32\%$ of Pass = 36 $\implies$ Pass Marks = $36 / 0.32 = 112.5$. Question me pehle hi diya hai ki Pass marks $45\%$ of N hain. Toh $0.45N = 112.5 \implies N = 11250 / 45 = 250$. Ab option dekho, $250$ range $243 < N < 252$ ke andar perfectly lie karta hai!

questions.q: The ratio of savings of two individuals is 6: 5. If one increases his savings by $15\%$ and the other by $10\%$, find their new savings ratio. (PHASE XIII(HS) - $\frac{28}{07}$/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, fractions se dar lagta hai toh base badha lo. 6 aur 5 ko 60 aur 50 maan lo. Pehle me $15\%$ bada, toh naya $60 \times 1.15 = 69$ hua. Dusre me $10\%$ bada, toh $50 \times 1.10 = 55$ hua. Naya ratio $69 : 55$ ban gaya. Ye kisi se nahi katega, isliye yahi final answer hai!

questions.q: A, B and C spend $75\%$, $80\%$ and $90\%$ of their incomes, respectively. If their savings are in the ratio 4: 6: 5 and the difference between the incomes of A and C is 25,500, then the income of B is?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Kharcha de kar bachat ka ratio de raha hai, ulta socho! Saving percentage nikal: A ka $25\%$, B ka $20\%$, C ka $10\%$. Agar inki income nikalni hai toh ratio of savings ko percentage se divide kar de. Income ratio = $4/0.25 : 6/0.20 : 5/0.10$. Yani $16 : 30 : 50$. Simplify kar de toh $8 : 15 : 25$ aayega. A aur C ka difference $17$ unit hai, jo $25500$ de rakha hai. $1$ unit = 1500. B ki income puchi hai ($15$ unit), toh $15 \times 1500 = 22500$ answer hoga!

questions.q: Rajan spent $10\%$ of his salary on rent. He spent $20\%$ of the remaining part of the salary on transport. After which he spent $40\%$ of the balance of the salary on food. Further, he spent $80\%$ of the balance on various bills. He deposits $\text{Rs. } 5000$ in the bank and kept the remaining $\text{Rs. } 1480$ for his own petty expenditure. Find his monthly salary (in Rs.).
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Ye Successive ka classic question hai. End me jo bacha wo hai $5000 + 1480 = 6480$. Salary ko S maan aur fractions me tod: $S \times 0.9 \times 0.8 \times 0.6 \times 0.2 = 6480$. Ya fir 9, 8, 6, 2 ko multiply karega toh $864$ aayega. $S \times 0.0864 = 6480$. Calculate karega toh aayega $64800000 / 864 = 75000$. Digital Sum bhi laga sakte the, 9 ka multiple nikal raha tha!

questions.q: The price of petrol is increased by $30\%$ then a man can purchase 9 lt. less petrol for $\text{Rs. } 780$. Find Original Purchase, Present Purchase, Original Rate, Present Rate
questions.s:
StepCalculation
1. Extra Money$30\%$ of 780 = 234 Rs.
2. Naya Rate234 / 9 = 26 Rs/L
3. Purana Rate26 / 1.3 = 20 Rs/L
4. Original Qty780 / 20 = 39 L
5. Present Qty780 / 26 = 30 L

Dekh bhai, direct format follow kar aur secondon me answer tick kar!

questions.q: If the volume of a cube increases by $119.7\%$, what is the percentage change in its total surface area?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Volume 3D (x³) me chalta hai. Volume $100$ se badh kar $219.7$ ho gaya, yani multiplier $2.197$ bana. Hamein 1D (side) par aane ke liye iska cube root lena padega. $\sqrt[3]{2.197} = 1.3$. Yani side $30\%$ badhi hai! Ab 2D (Surface Area) par jana hai toh side ka square kar do: $1.3^2 = 1.69$. $1$ se $1.69$ ho jana matlab direct $69\%$ ki vridhi. Pattern dimag me chipka lo!

questions.q: In an examination, a student who gets $20\%$ of the maximum marks fails by 5 marks. Another student who scores $30\%$ of the maximum marks gets 20 marks more than the pass marks. The necessary percentage required for passing is ?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, percentage difference aur marks difference equate kar! $30\% - 20\% = 10\%$ ka difference hai, aur udhar $20 - (-5) = 25$ marks ka gap. Agar $10\% = 25$ marks hai, toh 5 marks kitne percentage ke barabar honge? $(10/25) \times 5 = 2\%$. Pehla baccha 5 marks se fail hua tha, yani usko $2\%$ aur chahiye the. Pass percentage banega $20\% + 2\% = 22\%$. Smart calculation!

questions.q:
Quantity I: if the length of a rectangle is increased by $40\%$ while the breadth of the rectangle is decreased by $20\%$ then find percentage change in area of the rectangle?
Quantity II: if the side of a triangle is increased by $60\%$ while the height of a triangle is decreased by $40\%$ then find the percentage change in area of the triangle?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, dono jagah AB Rule (Successive) lagega. Q I ke liye: $40 - 20 - \frac{40 \times 20}{100} = +12\%$. Q II ke liye Area of triangle bhi $\text{Base} \times \text{Height}$ pe depend karti hai, so $60 - 40 - \frac{60 \times 40}{100} = 20 - 24 = -4\%$. Saaf dikh raha hai ki $+12\%$ bada hai $-4\%$ se, yani Quantity I > Quantity II. Bina tension direct compare.

questions.q: Two candidates P and Q are contesting elections in a city. $80\%$ of the registered voters voted in the election and P won the election by 160 votes. If Q had got $25\%$ more votes then the result of the election would have been a tie, then how many people did not vote?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, logical samasya hai! Tie ka matlab hai $Q_{new} = P_{new}$. Q ke votes $25\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{4}$) badh gaye, toh Q ne $1.25 Q$ le liye. Aur ye aadhe-aadhe ke barabar honge. Jisse nikalta hai $P = 1.5Q$. Ab initial difference dekho: $P - Q = 1.5Q - Q = 0.5Q$. Aur margin 160 de rakha hai. Agar $0.5Q = 160$ hai toh $Q = 320$. Toh $P = 480$. Total vote kitne pade? $320 + 480 = 800$. Ye 800 total registered ka $80\%$ the. Toh bache hue $20\%$ (jinhone vote nahi diya) kitne honge? $800$ ka $\frac{1}{4}$ yani 200 honge. Shandar sawal tha ye!

questions.q: In a society 500 people are living $45\%$ play cricket, $29\%$ play hockey and $48\%$ play badminton, $18\%$ didn't any play game while $5\%$ people play all three games. If $6\%$ people play cricket and hockey both and $27\%$ play cricket and badminton both find the number of people who play only badminton?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, $18\%$ kuch nahi khelte toh khelne wale log $100 - 18 = 82\%$ hue. Set theory ka wahi formula: $A \cup B \cup C = n(A) + n(B) + n(C) - n(A \cap B) - n(B \cap C) - n(A \cap C) + n(All)$. Values daalo: $82 = 45 + 29 + 48 - 6 - 27 - x + 5$. Solve karega toh $n(H \cap B) = x = 12\%$ aayega. Hame chahiye 'Only Badminton'. Only Badminton $= Total(B) - (C \cap B) - (H \cap B) + All$. Yahan dhyan rakhna $+All$ karte hain kyunki wo do baar ghata diya! $48 - 27 - 12 + 5 = 14\%$. 500 ka $14\%$ nikal de: $14 \times 5 = 70$. Set theory clear rakho.

questions.q: If the population of a town is 1,21,000 and it increases at an annual rate of $10\%$, what will be the difference between the population of the town after three years and the population of the town two years ago?
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Multipliers pakdo. Present $121,000$ hai. 2 saal pehle kya thi? Pop x $1.1^2 = 121000 \implies$ 2 years ago pop thi $1,00,000$. Ab 3 saal baad ki nikal. $121,000 \times 1.1^3 = 121,000 \times 1.331 = 1,61,051$. Hame dono ke beech ka gap chahiye: $1,61,051 - 1,00,000 = 61,051$. Calculation me $11$ ke powers yaad hone zaroori hain!

questions.q: Rishabh spends three fourth of his income. His income increases by $2x\%$ and his expenditure also increases by $x\%$. If the percentage of increase in his savings is $50\%$, then find value of $3.75x\%$ of 1440.
questions.s: Dekh bhai, $3/4$ expenditure ka matlab Income 4, Exp 3 aur Saving 1 hui. JSM ke concept se equation bana: $4 \times (2x) = 3 \times (x) + 1 \times (50)$. Yani $8x = 3x + 50 \implies 5x = 50 \implies x = 10$. Hame calculate karna hai $3.75x\%$ of 1440. Jab x 10 hai, toh ye $37.5\%$ ban jayega. $37.5\%$ ko hum pyaar se $\frac{3}{8}$ bulate hain. $1440 \times \frac{3}{8} = 180 \times 3 = 540$. Examiner confuse karna chahta hai, tu clarity rakh!

questions.q: In the previous government, party Q was in the opposition. Now increasing the seats by $33.33\%$ Q is the ruling party and thus party Q enjoys twice the majority than that of party P in the previous government. If there were only two parties P and Q and the fix no. of seats be 500 in the parliament of Hum-Tum, then the no. of seats of the Q in the new government is :
questions.s: Dekh bhai, word problem hai par ghabrana nahi. Q ki seats $33.33\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{3}$) badhi. Matlab purani seats $3$ unit thi, ab $4$ unit ho gayi. Pehle P = $500 - 3u$, aur ab P = $500 - 4u$ hui. Pehle P ki majority thi: $(500 - 3u) - 3u = 500 - 6u$. Ab Q ki majority hai: $4u - (500 - 4u) = 8u - 500$. Sawal ke mutabik nayi majority purani ki double hai: $8u - 500 = 2(500 - 6u)$. Solve karega toh $8u - 500 = 1000 - 12u \implies 20u = 1500 \implies u = 75$. Nayi government me Q ki seats = $4u = 4 \times 75 = 300$. Bawal logical approach!
